newsitem.title: USA: Magellan buy stake in Skyhook.
newsitem.headline: Magellan buy stake in Skyhook.

text.p: Magellan Technology Inc said on Friday it had completed the purchase of a 20 percent equity interest in privately held, Orem, Utah-based Skyhook Technologies.
Magellan said in a statement Skyhook Technologies had developed a patented, high-tech cargo management system for use with helicopters.
The proceeds of the Magellan investment are being used to complete the development and testing of the cargo management system, and the development of a related technology.
